snippet.title: The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park DLC - Gameplay Overview
snippet.description:
Echoes of Central Park launches November 3, 2026.
Pre-order now and unlock the Central Park-inspired mask at launch.
 
Get an in-depth look at Tom Clancy's The Division® 2: Echoes of Central Park and discover what awaits agents in New York's most iconic landmark. Investigate a mysterious distress signal, team up with three unique companions, uncover the truth behind a growing threat, and survive the dangers lurking within Central Park.
 
In this Gameplay Overview Trailer, learn more about:
 
 • Exploring Central Park and the Upper West Side for the first time in franchise history
 • Fighting alongside three unique companions with powerful combat abilities
 • Investigating a new narrative-driven campaign centered around the rescue of Miranda Veer
 • Facing new threats alongside returning enemy factions, including Black Tusk and Cleaners
 • Unlocking six new skill variants inspired by the horrors hidden within the park
 • Earning new gear, including a brand-new Exotic Weapon and gear set
 • Taking on a replayable endgame experience where every run into Central Park presents new dangers and rewards
 
Echoes of Central Park is a DLC for Tom Clancy's The Division® 2 and requires the base game to play.

About The Division 2:
Tom Clancy's The Division 2 is a shooter RPG with a thrilling campaign fully playable in co-op and multiple PVP modes.

In The Division 2, save your country in Washington, DC, and in the Warlords of New York expansion, hunt down Aaron Keener, a former Agent who has taken control of New York.

#Ubisoft #TheDivision2

Learn more about Ubisoft: www.ubisoftgroup.com
